text:
Site 8 June ruo 8 July 1990, Italy kwadoro FIFA World Cup, na-achịkọta otu 24 n’ụdị a ma ama ugbu a: otu isii nke anọ, ebe ndị abụọ kacha elu nke otu ọ bụla na ndị anọ kacha mma nke atọ na-aga n’ọkwa 16 otu nke na-ewepụ otu n’otu site na round of 16 ruo quarter-finals, semi-finals, egwuregwu nke atọ na final. A na-echeta asọmpi ahụ maka njide ya dịka ihe nkiri ya, na-edekọ nkezi dị ala nke oge ahụ nke 2.21 goolu kwa egwuregwu n’egwuregwu nchebe, nke na-enwe obere goolu. Ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bịara ruru 2,516,215 n’ime egwuregwu 52, nkezi nke 48,389 kwa egwuregwu.

Akụkọ ndị ahụ bịara n’oge mbụ. Cameroon meghere asọmpi ahụ site n’ịkwụsị ndị mmeri nwere aha bụ Argentina, ma mesịa bụrụ mba Africa mbụ ruru ọkwa quarter-final nke World Cup. Mba nnabata, kwa, chọtara dike a na-atụghị anya ya bụ Salvatore Schillaci, onye goolu isii ya duru Italy ruo ọnọdụ nke atọ ma kpọọ ya ma Golden Boot dịka onye kacha nweta goolu na Golden Ball dịka onye kacha mma n’asọmpi ahụ. Lothar Matthaus nwetara Silver Ball ebe Diego Maradona nwetara Bronze Ball.

Ọkwa knockout wetara esemokwu karịa ihe nkiri. England ruru semi-finals tupu ha tụfuo West Germany site na penalty, mgbasa ozi nke echeta ya na Britain jikọtara ya na ọrụ Luciano Pavarotti nke ‘Nessun dorma’ nke BBC mere. N’ụzọ dị ịtụnanya, ndị semi-final anọ niile, West Germany, Argentina, Italy na England, bụbu ndị mmeri World Cup.

Final nke Rome’s Stadio Olimpico, nke dị n’etiti West Germany na Argentina, nwere iwe ma bụrụ final World Cup mbụ nwere ịchụpụ mmadụ, n’ezie mmadụ abụọ, ebe Pedro Monzon na Gustavo Dezotti nke Argentina ka achụpụrụ. E kpebiri ya na nkeji 85 mgbe Andreas Brehme gbanwere penalty e nyere maka mmebi iwu na Rudi Völler, na-enye West Germany mmeri 1-0 na aha mba nke atọ. Mmeri ahụ mere onye nchịkwa Franz Beckenbauer bụ onye mbụ duuru ma chịkwaa otu mmeri World Cup, ma bụrụ mmeri ikpeazụ n’okpuru aha ‘West Germany’ tupu njikọta Germany.
